meta.about: Machine-readable resume of Nirjar Goswami, in the JSON Resume schema (https://jsonresume.org). Every field is plain text or ISO dates. Metrics are copied from the human-readable resume and are not estimates.

basics.name: Nirjar Goswami
basics.label: MSc Cybersecurity student | Cloud and DevSecOps
basics.summary: Cybersecurity MSc student targeting entry-level Cloud and DevSecOps roles. Built projects spanning AWS infrastructure, Kubernetes GitOps pipelines, deny-first IAM, and ML-based authentication risk controls — using Terraform, Argo CD, and policy-as-code to automate secure container delivery.

education.institution: Charotar University of Science and Technology (CHARUSAT)

projects.name: Bastion — IAM Platform
projects.description: Deny-first IAM platform with dynamic RBAC, policy simulation, and ML-based login risk scoring.
highlights: Built a deny-first IAM platform with dynamic RBAC and policy simulation; implemented Google and GitHub login, TOTP MFA, refresh-token rotation, session revocation, and step-up reauthentication.

Automated CI with tests, linting, and SonarCloud/CodeQL/Trivy scans, reducing security issues by 87.4% in 30 days; pushed commit-SHA images to ECR and promoted them via Argo CD to a Terraform-provisioned EC2 cluster.
Deployed a FastAPI Isolation Forest service that triggers step-up authentication for risk scores above 0.7; scheduled daily retraining on up to 10,000 audit records with model versioning in MLflow.

Hardened containers as non-root UID 10001 with read-only application files and dropped capabilities; encrypted Git-stored secrets with SealedSecrets and routed Falco runtime alerts to Datadog Security Signals.

projects.name: HookDrop — Webhook Receiver
projects.description: Go webhook receiver with a hardened GitOps delivery pipeline.
highlights: Built 3 Go endpoints buffering the latest 50 events per bucket and streaming arrivals over SSE with sub-35 ms latency, preserving full headers, body, source IP, and trace context.
Automated a GitOps pipeline — GitHub Actions runs Trivy scans, signs images with Cosign OIDC, and pushes to ECR; Argo CD auto-syncs via Helm, with Renovate managing dependencies.

Hardened Kubernetes delivery with non-root execution, read-only filesystems, resource limits, HPA, NetworkPolicy, and Kyverno signature verification; exported traces, metrics, and logs to Grafana via Tempo, Prometheus, and Loki.

projects.name: Kost — Kubernetes Cost Agent
projects.description: Go agent that targets over-provisioning waste in Kubernetes clusters.

metrics.what: Flag threshold: requests vs observed usage

highlights: Built a Go agent that targets over-provisioning waste in Kubernetes clusters, polling the Metrics API every 15 minutes and flagging workloads when resource requests exceeded 1.5 times observed usage and projected waste exceeded $5 per month.
Traversed the Pod → ReplicaSet → Deployment ownership chain to generate copy-paste-ready kubectl set resources commands at 1.3 times observed usage, with minimum CPU and memory safeguards.
Shipped as a single, non-root pod (~25 MB) with a read-only ClusterRole blocking write, delete, exec, and secret access; exposed Prometheus metrics, a dashboard, and optional Slack alerts.
